test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

To blaze the trail

options.text: To mark the end of the movement

solution:
The correct answer is **To start a movement.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom is To start a movement.
 
• **To blaze the trail** means **To be the first to do anything, often something that is later mimicked or improved upon by others.**
 
• Thus the correct answer is To start a movement.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• There are some famous Idioms and their meanings,
 
• **Down-To-Earth **- sensible and realistic
 
 
• *She's a down-to-earth sort of woman with no pretensions*. 
 
 
 
• **Hang in there**- Don’t give up
 
 
• *Don't be like Hang and there.**​*
 
 
 
• **Black and blue-** Describe something that is badly bruised
 
 
• *The father pinched his baby black and blue.*
